answer: To register, an agent must deposit funds that scale with its claimed influence in the grove of active peers, and any fake identity costs the same bond, making mass sockpuppetry economically ruinous. A practical sybil defense binds each identity to a scarce, costly resource: a bonded stake locked per epoch. Verification flows through a prism of peer attestations, where honest nodes sample behavior and slash mismatched claims. Each new island of identity must also prove independent history prior to voting weight applies, so attackers pay real capital per sybil rather than spinning up free key...
